name: SOL zfav maker, gap-proportional Kelly
description: sol-zfav-early's post-only favourite bid (SOL spot past the strike, 540..300 s to close), entered and sized by the gap between the spot-implied probability Phi(z) and the bid price, with quarter-Kelly sizing on a half-shrunk probability. Money goes where spot confirmation is least priced in (cheap favourites) instead of equally onto 97c fills.
hypothesis: The zfav maker family's edge per contract falls with the favourite's price (SOL early +8c at <=90c vs +0.9c at 95-97c; also XRP, DOGE, ETH+BTC), which is what a Phi(z)-price gap predicts. Trading only when Phi(z)-px >= 3c (z>=1.0) and sizing by Kelly on prob = px + 0.5*gap should raise the contract-weighted edge over the flat-size parent (+2.27c dev) and cut the weak 95-97c fills. Wrong if the full walk-forward per-contract result is below the parent's, or the low-z (1.0-1.5) cheap fills are adversely selected (check by z band). Parameters k=0.5, gmin=0.03, kelly:0.25 fixed before any test.
